actions.name: Thunderclap
actions.description: As a standard action, use the thundergauntlet as a ranged weapon with the blast special property and 30-foot range. If the mech has two thundergauntlets, it can use both to deal medium damage rather than low damage.

description.value:
An armored gauntlet that generates devastating sonic shockwaves.

Special: Thunderclap (1 PP) - Create a sonic burst that damages and deafens nearby enemies.
